Snacks

Cherry banana soft ice

Cseresznyés banánfagyi

8 months+ Adjusted 120 min 4 portions

Serve a soft spoonful only after you have checked for pits. Do not offer whole cherries.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 150 g Cherries (Every pit removed; check twice)
  • 1 large Ripe banana (Peeled and chopped)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Pit every cherry and look through the fruit again for pits.
  2. Blend the cherries with the banana until smooth.
  3. Freeze in a shallow tub, stirring once, for about two hours.
  4. Stop at a soft scoop, not a hard block.
  5. Mash before serving and glance once more for any pit fragment.

Adjusted

Whole cherries and pits are the hazard. A pit or a whole cherry can block the airway.

Pit the cherries, blend them with banana, and soft-freeze the mix with no sugar. Check again that every pit is gone.
